subject: European vendor VAT, invoice workflow and PO netting
messages:
From: Elena Kovač <elena.kovac@atlascorp.hr>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28 09:12 +01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor onboarding - VAT info attached

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the onboarding packet. I've attached our completed supplier onboarding form and a copy of AtlasCorp's EU VAT registration (Croatia VAT ID: HR12345678901). We are registered for B2B domestic supply and provide invoices with VAT where applicable. For customers in other EU countries we can apply the reverse-charge (no VAT on our invoice) when a valid EU VAT number is provided.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, eu_vat_certificate.pdf

A few practical notes to help you:
- We usually send invoices in EUR with VAT shown separately.
- If Redwood issues a PO and confirms your VAT number, we can zero-rate the invoice and include the note: "Reverse charge - Article 44".
- Payment terms we discussed earlier: Net 30.

If you need any additional tax paperwork (power of attorney, fiscal representative) let us know and I can escalate.

Best,
Elena
Vendor Operations
AtlasCorp d.o.o.

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Kovač <elena.kovac@atlascorp.hr>
Date: 2026-10-29 10:05 -07:00
Subject: FW: Redwood vendor onboarding - VAT info attached

Looping finance and procurement on AtlasCorp's submission. They provided an EU VAT ID (Croatia) and say they will zero-rate via reverse charge when we provide a valid VAT number.

Question for tax/finance: Do we treat this as: 1) Redwood issues PO net (no VAT) and self-account for VAT under reverse charge, or 2) accept vendor invoice with VAT and reclaim later? Also: do we need the vendor to provide any EU-specific certificates beyond the VAT registration PDF they attached?

Attached: proposed_po_v1.pdf (draft PO to be reviewed for net vs gross amounts).

Thanks — please advise next steps so I can reply to Elena.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Sourcing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29 13:47 -04:00
Subject: Re: FW: Redwood vendor onboarding - VAT info attached

Monica —

Good to see they have a valid HR VAT number. Quick notes:
- For EU vendors with valid VAT IDs and B2B relationships, standard practice is to issue PO net and self-account for VAT via reverse charge. That keeps us from paying VAT upfront and simplifies reclaim.
- Procurement needs a signed onboarding form + the VAT certificate on file (they provided both). Please ensure the VAT number is validated against VIES (we can do that).
- Finance (rachel), confirm that our AP system can host the vendor VAT number and produce the right tax treatment when we convert the PO to an invoice match. If not, we will need the vendor to put VAT on their invoice and we reclaim later which is messy.

Also, send the vendor a DocuSign with the vendor portal terms and the purchase order once the tax stance is confirmed.

Lauren
Head of Strategic Procurement

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01 08:22 -07:00
Subject: RE: FW: Redwood vendor onboarding - VAT info attached

Quick finance guidance:
- If AtlasCorp provides a VAT number that validates in VIES, we should:
  1) Set them up in our vendor master with the VAT ID.
  2) Issue the PO net (no VAT line) citing reverse charge.
  3) On receipt, our AP team will self-account for VAT in our local tax reporting.
- If VIES validation fails or they are not B2B registered in the supplying country, then we may end up receiving an invoice with VAT. In that case AP will process the invoice gross and Finance will handle reclaim where eligible.

Action items:
- Monica: request VAT number validation screenshot or let us validate and confirm.
- Monica: have vendor sign the onboarding form and return.
- Rachel: please confirm whether our bill-to country (US entity) requires any withholding at source for this supplier — my preliminary read is no for EU vendor supplying services to a US customer, but confirm please.

Marcus
Finance Manager, AP

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Kovač <elena.kovac@atlascorp.hr>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02 14:03 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood vendor onboarding - VAT info attached

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Next steps from Redwood:
1) We will validate your HR VAT number in VIES and confirm status to you by EOD tomorrow.
2) Please sign the attached onboarding form (I've resent via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-AtlasCorp-2026) and return.
3) Once validated and signed, Redwood will create the vendor record and issue the PO net, with the invoice treatment noted as: "Reverse charge — customer to self-account".

Rachel / Marcus: if either of you identify additional documentation we need (fiscal rep, W-8/W-9 equivalents for non-US), call it out and I'll request it.

Elena — two small asks on the invoice format to ensure smooth AP processing:
- Display your VAT number clearly and the statement: "Reverse charge applies — EU VAT not charged to customer."
- Provide the invoice in EUR and include a clear description tying the invoice to Redwood PO # (we'll provide PO number in the final).

Thanks — I'll follow up after the VIES check.

Best,
Monica
Senior Sourcing Manager
Redwood Inference
